name: CINC
description: CINC is an all-in-one real-estate lead generation and conversion platform with IDX websites, CRM, automated nurturing, communications, advertising, team management and mobile tools.
agentUseSummary: CINC is visible as a security-review preview. Relay will not collect credentials or call its deep two-way CRM API until CINC provides an approved third-party authorization and data-minimization contract.

capabilities.label: Review bounded CINC integration access
capabilities.description: If CINC approves a least-privilege contract, expose only exact-account, privacy-redacted tools after security review.

blocked.label: Capture CINC credentials
blocked.description: Relay will not request platform passwords, session material, API keys or partner credentials for this preview.

blocked.label: Read private CINC CRM data
blocked.description: Leads, contacts, preferences, communications, activities, notes, routing, transactions and team data are unavailable.

blocked.label: Change records or contact leads
blocked.description: Two-way CRM writes, lead routing, campaigns, email, SMS, calls, advertising and other external actions are unavailable.

blocked.label: Run CINC actions before security review
blocked.description: No CINC tool is callable until CINC documents approved third-party authentication, granular scopes, immutable account binding, lifecycle, limits, audit identifiers and distribution terms.

approvalProfiles.label: CINC authorization security review
approvalProfiles.description: Connection, installation and agent actions remain unavailable because CINC's public material describes deep two-way CRM integrations without a public least-privilege authorization lifecycle.

runtimeSupport.description: No OpenClaw tools are callable before CINC approves a least-privilege integration contract.
No Hermes tools are callable before CINC approves a least-privilege integration contract.

providerSetup.blocker: CINC advertises a Public API for deep two-way CRM integrations but does not publish a distributable authentication flow, granular scopes, immutable account claims, token expiration, rotation or revocation, request limits, audit identifiers or general third-party onboarding terms.
providerSetup.nextAction: Ask CINC at integrations@cincpro.com for an approved production third-party contract covering authentication, exact account and user binding, granular read scopes, token lifecycle, limits, auditing, privacy redaction and distribution. Re-run security review before implementing typed bounded tools.

evidence.supports: CINC advertises a Public API for deep two-way third-party CRM integrations and directs prospective integration partners to integrations@cincpro.com, without publishing the authorization contract.
CINC describes lead generation, IDX websites, CRM, automations, dialer, messaging, advertising, mobile and team-management capabilities spanning sensitive client data and external communication.
CINC's privacy policy covers personal and usage information processed across its services, supporting a least-privilege and data-minimization requirement.
CINC's terms impose privacy and legal obligations for CRM and real-estate data; Relay must not infer unpublished API authorization or distribution rights.
